y_failures: Also links the Agathyrsi 'broad, dyed, and denser marks' line to Pomponius Mela when the page gives it to Ammianus; credits the Assyrian marks to 'Scribonius Largus' when the page is Rhodius's commentary quoting Lucian
reason: Both answers misattribute the Agathyrsi quotation, but X has more attribution slips, while Y's quotes (Porta on tattooing with needle and colophony, the Igorot process) closely match the pages.
